stock.description: Yan Tat Group Holdings Limited is an investment holding company specializing in the global manufacturing and distribution of printed circuit boards (PCBs). The firm's expansive market reach includes Mainland China, Europe, Hong Kong, the broader Asian region, North America, Africa, Oceania, and South America. In addition to its core production activities, Yan Tat is also involved in the trading of PCBs and holds property assets. Its technologically advanced products serve a wide array of sectors, such as the automotive industry, telecommunications equipment, medical devices, industrial automation systems, and consumer electronics. Established in 1989, the company's headquarters are located in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong. Yan Tat Group Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Million Pearl Holdings Ltd.
